images.alt: Illustrative menswear campaign featuring an ecru shirt and sand trousers
images.prompt: Wide editorial fashion photograph of one fictional adult Indian male model, approximately 28-35 years old, wearing the exact ecru p01 button-down shirt and sand p05 chinos from the product references. He stands naturally in softly lit contemporary grey-stone architecture. Garment details and face must be believable. Position the model in the right third; leave calm, lightly textured negative space across the left 40 percent for HTML copy added later. Keep the entire head and trouser silhouette inside a safe crop zone. No text inside the image.

images.alt: Portrait crop of the illustrative ecru-shirt menswear campaign
images.crop_instructions: Crop around the model from the desktop master. Keep head, collar, shirt and as much of the trouser silhouette as possible. Remove excess left negative space. Do not stretch or generate a different garment/model. Note any required upscale.

images.alt: Sample ecru long-sleeve button-down shirt photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single ecru long-sleeve men's button-down shirt, photographed front-on as an elegant ghost-mannequin product photograph against pure white. Relaxed straight silhouette, button-down collar, one left chest patch pocket, seven small matte bone-coloured front buttons and simple button cuffs. Fine woven cotton-like texture. Sleeves arranged naturally and symmetrically. Full garment visible with at least 10 percent margin above collar and below hem. No hanger, mannequin, tags, logos or text. This is the master reference for every p01 view.

images.alt: Sample indigo long-sleeve shirt photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single deep indigo men's long-sleeve shirt in the same premium white-background ghost-mannequin studio style and camera scale as p01. A clean point collar, one left chest patch pocket, restrained dark matte buttons, button cuffs and a straight relaxed hem. Show subtle woven texture and realistic folds. Full garment visible, ample crop margins, no visible tags, hanger, logos or text.

images.alt: Sample black crew-neck T-shirt photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single unbranded black men's crew-neck T-shirt, front-on ghost-mannequin product photograph on pure white, matching the other catalogue shots. Relaxed shoulders, short sleeves, subtle ribbed neckline, straight hem, realistic medium-weight cotton-like jersey. Preserve visible shadow detail rather than making the shirt a flat black silhouette. Full garment in frame, no prints, tags, logos or text.

images.alt: Sample sage overshirt with two chest pockets photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single muted sage men's overshirt, front-on ghost-mannequin photograph on pure white, matching catalogue scale. Two symmetrical chest patch pockets with straight flaps, a simple point collar, five dark matte front buttons, long sleeves and button cuffs. Substantial cotton-twill-like surface, relaxed layering fit, clean straight hem. No hanger, prints, tags, logos or text; full garment with safe margins.

images.alt: Sample sand-coloured chinos photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single pair of sand-coloured men's chinos in a premium front-on ghost-mannequin product photograph on pure white. Full waistband and both trouser legs visible, gently tapered shape, belt loops, discreet fly, slanted side pockets, restrained twill texture and natural drape. No belt, shoes, mannequin, brand labels or text. Keep both hems in frame with safe margins; match the catalogue lighting.

images.alt: Sample charcoal short-sleeve polo photographed from the front
images.prompt: Single charcoal men's short-sleeve polo shirt, front-on ghost-mannequin product photograph on pure white. Clean ribbed collar, three-button placket, lightly textured pique-like fabric, relaxed straight silhouette, small side vents and no chest logo. Preserve texture in dark fabric. Full garment visible, same catalogue scale and soft shadows as the other product shots, no hanger, tags, prints or text.

images.alt: Back view of the same sample ecru button-down shirt
images.prompt: Using p01 front as the garment reference, photograph the exact same ecru shirt from the back in the identical white-background ghost-mannequin setup. Match shade, weave, sleeves, collar, cuffs and hem proportions. Show a simple back yoke and clean central drape, without adding decorative details. No front pocket or front buttons on the back. Full garment visible with safe margins. No text or logos.

images.alt: Close-up of the sample ecru shirt collar, button and woven texture
images.prompt: Macro product detail of the exact p01 ecru shirt. Frame a portion of its button-down collar, one matte bone-coloured button, neat stitching and fine woven cotton-like texture. Soft side light, precise fibres without artificial over-sharpening, restrained shadows, shallow but useful depth of field. Match the master shirt's fabric and colour. No branding or text.

images.alt: Illustrative model wearing the sample ecru shirt with sand chinos

Show garment fit and full sleeves clearly. Match buttons, collar and pocket to p01; do not invent accessories, jewellery, logos or text.

images.alt: Illustrative close-up of ecru, indigo and sage woven fabrics
images.prompt: Premium still-life macro of three neatly arranged unbranded woven fabric swatches in ecru, indigo and sage. Believable yarn texture, gentle folds and soft daylight on a clean white work surface. Minimal composition, useful negative space, no labels, certificates, tools with logos or text. An illustrative material study, not evidence of a particular fibre composition or manufacturing claim.

Reveal restrained, realistic construction detail through soft side light. No workers, factories, country-of-origin clues, handmade claims, scissors, logos or text. Do not add decorative stitching.
